workflow: synthetic missed web form or after-hours inquiry
worker snapshot/restart without a second appointment
acceptance: lead identity is the idempotency key
duplicate form submit and after-hours inquiry of the same lead share one store row
complete leads rescue once to the class follow-up and appointment lanes
incomplete or hold leads route once to HELD_INCOMPLETE with zero appointments
worker restart after a mid-rescue crash resumes to one appointment
rollback of a crashed run returns a clean un-rescued state
a finished rescue is not rollbackable and stays single-rescued
same id with different bytes returns LEAD_CONFLICT and keeps the original rescue
PII-shaped keys and live phone/email/VIN values are refused
live CRM writes, real dealerships, outreach, and Stripe remain zero

commercial.refund: If the accepted diagnostic is not delivered inside the one-business-day window, the paid diagnostic amount is refunded unless the buyer elects in writing to receive one free next-business-day repair instead.

data_boundary: browser-local synthetic fixtures only; no real dealership; no PII; no server submission
decision_boundary: rescue routing only; never live CRM write, outreach, or a Stripe charge
